lifted.anchor: This last chapter gives the work a form.
A document that rebuilds itself still needs a structure
The **Introduction** states the question and why it is worth asking.
The **Methods** section says exactly what was done
The **Results** section reports what was found
The **Discussion** says what the results mean.
One short piece remains, and the portfolio is not complete without it
This is the last chapter, and looking ahead now means looking past the book.
That sequence is what the book's title has been describing all along.
